"""Driver for the first IR-1 frozen-58 evaluation (preregistration section 10, item 4).

Adds no retrieval or scoring logic: each condition runs eval.run_eval.evaluate unchanged, with the
module's `search` swapped for the frozen integration (ir1_integration.search_ir1) and the switches
of that condition; the baseline condition uses the real app.search.search. Metrics come from
run_eval.summarise unchanged. Raw output is written once, before any analysis.
"""

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import psycopg

import eval.run_eval as run_eval
from app.config import REPO_ROOT, get_settings
from eval.bench.run_bench import keep_awake
from eval.experiments import ir1_integration as ia
from eval.experiments.ir1_engine import Switches
from eval.experiments.ir1_request import load_frozen_requests, plan_all

CONDITIONS = [("baseline", None), ("ir1_full", Switches()), ("ir1_full_repeat", Switches()),
              ("ablate_m2", Switches(m2=False)), ("ablate_m3", Switches(m3=False)),
              ("ablate_m4", Switches(m4=False))]
FROZEN_FILES = ["eval/experiments/IR1_PREREGISTRATION.md", "eval/experiments/ir1_frozen58_annotations.yaml",
                "eval/experiments/IR1_CLARIFICATIONS.md", "eval/experiments/IR1_STAGE2_CLARIFICATIONS.md",
                "eval/experiments/IR1_STAGE2_ABLATION_ADDENDUM.md", "eval/experiments/ir1_request.py",
                "eval/experiments/ir1_engine.py", "eval/experiments/ir1_integration.py",
                "eval/experiments/ir1_gate_a.py", "eval/queries/generated.yaml", "eval/queries/human.yaml"]


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def main(out: Path) -> None:
    keep_awake()
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    queries, query_hashes = run_eval.load_queries()
    plans = {p.request_id: p for p in plan_all(load_frozen_requests())}
    assert len(queries) == 58 and {q.id for q in queries} == set(plans)
    for q in queries:
        assert plans[q.id].audit.raw_text == q.query and not q.filters
    by_text = {q.query: plans[q.id] for q in queries}
    assert len(by_text) == 58
    real_search = run_eval.search
    report = {
        "experiment": "IR-1 frozen-58, first result observation",
        "started_utc": started,
        "commit": subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                 cwd=REPO_ROOT, check=True).stdout.strip(),
        "command": " ".join([Path(sys.executable).name] + sys.argv),
        "driver_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        "driver_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        "corpus": run_eval.corpus_info(),
        "query_files": query_hashes,
        "frozen_files": {f: sha((REPO_ROOT / f).read_bytes()) for f in FROZEN_FILES},
        "conditions": {},
    }
    url = get_settings().database_url
    try:
        with psycopg.connect(url, prepare_threshold=None) as conn:
            report["database"] = dict(zip(("documents", "revisions", "index_rows", "links"), conn.execute(
                "select (select count(*) from dcc.document), (select count(*) from dcc.revision), "
                "(select count(*) from dcc.search_entry), (select count(*) from dcc.information_link)").fetchone()))
            for name, switches in CONDITIONS:
                per_query: dict[str, dict] = {}

                def fn(conn_, query, filters, limit=10, switches=switches, per_query=per_query):
                    assert not filters.active() and limit == 10
                    p = by_text[query]
                    if switches is None:
                        response, record = real_search(conn_, query, filters, limit=limit), None
                    else:
                        r = ia.search_ir1(conn_, p, switches)
                        response, record = r.response, r.interpretation
                    per_query[p.request_id] = {"response_sha256": sha(response.model_dump_json().encode()),
                                               "interpretation": record}
                    return response

                run_eval.search = fn
                try:
                    outcomes = run_eval.evaluate(conn, queries)
                finally:
                    run_eval.search = real_search
                report["conditions"][name] = {
                    "switches": None if switches is None else asdict(switches),
                    "engine": "app.search.search (baseline-fts-v1)" if switches is None else ia.ENGINE_LABEL,
                    "summary": run_eval.summarise(outcomes),
                    "outcomes": [asdict(o) for o in outcomes],
                    "per_query": per_query,
                }
                print(f"{name}: {len(outcomes)} queries evaluated", flush=True)
    except Exception as e:                                                  # record, then stop
        report["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        raise
    finally:
        report["finished_utc"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
        out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"raw results written to {out}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(Path(sys.argv[1]))
